context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features verified working: (1) Excel Export - GET /api/members/export/excel returns .xlsx file with headers: Nombre, Numero de Socio, Telefono, Email, Estado, Fecha Registro. Sorted alphabetically by name. (2) Phone Column - Members table shows 'Teléfono' column, member edit modal has phone field. (3) Datos Page - /admin/data accessible from sidebar, has gym selector for super admin, Excel download button. (4) Gym Selectors - Analytics, POS, Forms pages all have gym selector dropdown for super admin (data-testid: analytics-gym-select, pos-gym-select, forms-gym-select, data-gym-select).
